_note: Hand-edited team file. pipeline/build_named_sites.py turns it into docs/data/sites.json (do not edit that one). Numbers are NOT typed here: Earth site values are read from the Earth grid (build_grid.py) at each site's 1-degree cell, Moon/Mars values from docs/data/targets.json (build_targets.py). 'tags' are team-curated geology labels: put a citation in 'tags_src' (paper, DOI or agency page). Tags are shown but not scored by default. Body facts must each carry a source. 'analog_for' lists the bodies (moon, mars) an Earth site is used as an analog for; auto-ranking only pairs a site with targets on those bodies. It is a team curation like the tags: cite it in 'tags_src' when you can.

earth.name: Earth

sites.name: Shackleton Crater
sites.coord_src: Site marker carried over from the original dataset. Not yet checked against a gazetteer.
sites.summary: Crater at the lunar south pole with permanently shadowed ground where water ice may be trapped.

Basaltic volcanic ground, used for regolith and rover trials.
